item.description:
Release v5.19.1

Changes since v5.19.0

  • docs(context): add llm context provider plan
  • feat(booklet-maker): configure plugin policy per host
  • feat(booklet-maker): restore settings window
  • feat(booklet-maker): specialize plugin composition
  • feat(context): add background summary provider
  • feat(context): persist conversation summaries
  • feat(context): route llm history through provider
  • feat(message-list): change empty state text to show project-specific prompt
  • feat(message-list): change empty state text to show project-specific prompt with localization support
  • fix: prevent git status pipe deadlocks
  • fix(agent-loop): allow chat to continue past ask_user
  • fix(app-icon-designer): align host composition and settings layout
  • fix(booklet-maker): support unified multiplatform app
  • fix(chat): cancel editor bindings during teardown
  • fix(content-view): show empty state when no plugin view is registered
  • fix(lumi): link codex provider product
  • fix(rag): avoid blocking chat during indexing
  • fix(rag): avoid cross-project indexing stalls
  • perf(chat): load llm history off main actor
  • perf(chat): persist user messages off main thread
